title: How curiosity drove a line operator to change PepsiCo’s potato chip production
summary: With a unique flavor of curiosity, persistence and belief in better, Felix Stan turned everyday observations on the factory floor into opportunities for innovation at PepsiCo.
body_markdown:
Today, Stan's focus extends well beyond a single idea. He works across operations to improve productivity, strengthen manufacturing standards and identify new opportunities to make processes more efficient.


That work is guided by a simple belief. "There is always a better way to do something," he said, "even if a process already works well."


It’s the same mindset that keeps him energized after more than two decades — and the same advice he offers anyone just beginning their own career: stay curious. He also helps pass that knowledge on through PepsiCo Romania’s Technical Boot Camp Internship program, where he has mentored four cohorts of future engineers.


Through PepsiCo, he found opportunities to learn, travel, share knowledge across countries and turn ideas into real business impact. It's a journey that continues to surprise him, driven by the same curiosity that first drew him onto the factory floor decades earlier.


“Knowing that my work can improve safety, productivity, quality, or sustainability is what keeps me engaged and excited to come to work even after 25 years,” he said.


*This story is part of A Unique Flavor — a series spotlighting incredible people across PepsiCo with bold ambitions and standout talents.*
